## 📋 Description of Changes
Please include a concise summary of the changes and the relevant issue or context.

## 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] 💅 UI/UX enhancement (visual styling, accessibility, micro-interactions)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization (bundle size, load time, rendering speed)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (README, CHANGELOG, schemas)
- [ ] 🔧 Refactoring & maintenance (clean code without behavioral modifications)

## ✅ Verification Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project standards and clean code conventions.
- [ ] Production build passes cleanly (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Verified responsiveness across desktop and mobile screens.
- [ ] Conventional Commit format used for all commits.
